The discussion focused on adjusting the dwell time and frequency calculations for company 7965. Initially, [p1] requested that the dwell time calculation be enabled using the internal method. Regarding frequency, [p1] noted that while a basic frequency was used, multipliers dependent on the number of days were commented out in the code. [me] confirmed that the frequency formula had been uncommented and found previous chat history confirming when the formula was disabled.

[p1] stated that leaving the calculation with only sensor data (without multipliers) resulted in high numbers, whereas including the multipliers provided a more adequate result.
decisions: The dwell time calculation for company 7965 is to be enabled using the internal method.
Frequency multipliers dependent on the number of days were uncommented and reactivated.
